planted_contradictions.detail: The cleaner puts the van's arrival at about 01:10; the camera shows it at 01:39:20 and the alarm first trips at 01:42:18.
The owner says K02 locked the customer door at about 18:00 and went home; the access log shows K02 re-entered at 23:48 and locked again at 00:03:55 (armed 00:05:10).

The owner says he arrived about 02:20 after a call at about 02:00; the monitoring-station call is logged at 01:58:00 and the disarm at 02:21:30 (consistent), so this is a consistency control, not a contradiction.
